purpose: Record the fresh four-round TaskManager development regression after the bounded five-residual probe

prompt_attribution: The newly added exact five-error specialization was not activated in this fresh batch because round 3 left only two error families. The result supports the capped four-round pipeline on this reused development sample, not a causal claim about the five-error specialized prompt.
boundary: Automatic validation and visual pass do not imply browser interaction equivalence. This is reused development material, not independent holdout evidence.
